text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is about to
begin! Of
course, everyone has their
attention fixed on the
battle between
the Empress, Эйр Грув, and the

Otherworldly Front-Runner, Silence
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The stands are awash with excitement!
Everyone's
on the edge of their seat!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I bet Suzuka's gonna fly ahead and leave
Air
Groove in the dust!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text: I was at the Sapporo Kinen, so I know Air Groove's got this in the bag!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text: I'm just about to see Эйр Грув off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We've come all this way.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: All that's left is to run.

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I just need to give it everything I
have.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Suzuka...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'm so relieved.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: About what?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I can feel your power again. You're back
to the
Эйр Грув I know so well.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Actually... not quite.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
There's still something different about
you now.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You look faster and sharper than the last
time we
raced. It feels like you might get
ahead of me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You're stronger than I've ever seen you.
That's the
feeling I get.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I really enjoyed running in the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And looking at you now... I feel like I
can run even
faster than back then.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what I wanted to hear,
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing you run even
faster than
at the Takarazuka Kinen...
before I pass you and
claim my victory.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Good. But don't expect me to go down
without a
fight.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out now. Let's have a good
race out
there.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'm not afraid any longer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That's right. Believe in me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I am the Empress. I am the challenger
who drives
all Umamusume forward.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: And... I'm your ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
